title: Ten Degrees Doubles It, But Only Near Room Temperature
summary: The Arrhenius law is exponential in one over temperature, not in temperature. Nudge the rail ten kelvin at a time and watch a rule of thumb everyone learns as a constant slide from 2.70 down to 1.29.

sources.title: Arrhenius, Uber die Reaktionsgeschwindigkeit bei der Inversion von Rohrzucker durch Sauren, Z. Phys. Chem. 4 (1889) 226-248
